name: Gestures_Shy_1
short_caption: The robot brings its hands together in front of its chest, gently tapping its index fingers in a shy, hesitant gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises both arms, bringing its hands together in front of its tablet. It tilts its head slightly downward and forward while using its right index finger to hesitantly tap or touch its left index finger. After a brief pause in this timid posture, it lowers both arms back down to its sides and returns its head to the neutral position.
